process.disclosure: bounded process/build/metrics or exact public contract; metrics retain existing deployment authentication
process.eligibility: existing listener policy; no membership permission

self.disclosure: own access and bounded capabilities; no other user permission inspection
self.eligibility: OAuth enforcement unchanged; per-capability permission checks for sensitive operations

access.scopeSource: tenant plus administrator realm for grants/groups
access.eligibility: last usable admin, terminal offboarding, revision/reason, reserved built-ins, no group administrator

namespace.scopeSource: exact addressed namespace, authorized directory population; creation uses tenant
namespace.disclosure: only accessible directory records; compact labels on authorized resources do not enumerate the directory
namespace.eligibility: trusted ID lookup, no moves, scope validation and revision

publisher.disclosure: publisher directory/evidence only with explicit permission; compact resource summaries separate
publisher.eligibility: publisher administration/domain approval distinct; revisions and active-release safety

content.scopeSource: canonical resource namespace through same-tenant parent/reference
content.disclosure: authorized metadata/history/exact content according to permission; digests do not grant access
content.eligibility: namespace spoofing refused, immutable evidence, current audit-before-content, deleted/draft rules; edits require read, deletion requires creator or protected administrator

review.actors: active human or service member; preserve existing actor policy
review.disclosure: submission metadata or evidence through authorized target
review.eligibility: current validation and no self-approval; action authority does not bypass eligibility

release.disclosure: selected release with authorized read capability
release.eligibility: approved review, publisher/domain/validation, immutable evidence, ETag and legal state transition

search.scopeSource: authorized local namespaces; external results separately require tenant federation.discover
search.disclosure: predicate before count/facets/ranking/paging; no inaccessible provenance or suppression by hidden local matches
search.eligibility: origins authorized before live query disclosure; unknown targets hidden; lexical/hybrid same authority

source.disclosure: source metadata distinct from raw observation/credential-private evidence
source.eligibility: current source revision, egress/audience/query policy, inspect-before-connect, complete snapshots preserved

adoption.scopeSource: tenant source evidence plus destination namespace from trusted input/lookup
adoption.disclosure: exact occurrence under source.read_evidence and new local draft
adoption.eligibility: complete occurrence, immutable provenance, no silent discovery adoption or execution

publication.eligibility: whole snapshot transition distinct from namespace release, approved host, completeness/work bounds, activation revalidation

jobs.scopeSource: trusted Job kind and retained tenant/target
jobs.disclosure: bounded target-authorized Job projection; no execution payload or mixed private snapshot
jobs.eligibility: job permission AND owner-family permission; source.sync=>source.read/manage; source.trust_verify=>source.read_evidence, with source.manage AND federation.discover for cancel/retry; publication.generate=>publication.read/generate; semantic.reindex=>operations.reindex; unknown kinds refuse and target checks are family-specific; trust status remains readable after source changes/removal, while retry rechecks current source, policy and credential eligibility

audit.disclosure: privileged tenant-wide audit or bounded deterministic export; not object-filtered documents
audit.eligibility: required private-read evidence, bounds and immutable audit

webhook.disclosure: endpoint/delivery evidence; one-time secrets only under exact command result authority
webhook.eligibility: HTTPS fetch rules, configured capability, rotation/revision, safe current replay of secrets

feedback.scopeSource: own membership or tenant moderator; creation also needs resource.read on target
feedback.actors: human for own listing/submission/edit/withdraw; active human or service member for own exact read and moderator operations under existing actor policy
feedback.disclosure: private own/admin current text; replay only text-free receipt
feedback.eligibility: immutable context, authorship/moderation/state checks; resource visibility loss does not disclose other records or erase own submission

operations.eligibility: current enabled profile, bounded target/valid payload; no schema-owner migration authority

discovery.scopeSource: configured host/audience and active immutable snapshot
discovery.actors: anonymous only when enabled; authenticated host requires active member plus discovery.read
discovery.disclosure: only activated allowlisted public artifacts/metadata; never private draft filtering
discovery.eligibility: host/tenant/scope ceiling; explicit change from current authenticated host active-membership-only admission; private revoke does not unpublish public entries

internal.actors: internal execution only; service classification or a worker-like subject is insufficient
internal.disclosure: caller retains host/tenant/target boundary; no user permission bypass
internal.eligibility: typed work, kind/lease/target and domain eligibility; initiating attribution separate

ratings.scopeSource: Exact released version or admitted actual source generation; tenant-scoped aggregates.
ratings.actors: Active verified humans own opinions; finite tenant administrators moderate and configure sharing.
ratings.disclosure: Only admitted discovery targets receive aggregates; own records remain disposable after visibility loss.
ratings.eligibility: Current source/policy/credential fences, exact namespace permission and optional OAuth ceilings.

mcp.scopeSource: request-owned authenticated member; exact tool uses existing Control read authority
mcp.disclosure: six bounded metadata tools; self-access excludes private identity fields; no execution or native documents
mcp.eligibility: default-off finite stateless HTTP; valid protocol and mirrored headers precede read; resource tools require catalog.read when enforced; no shared credential/session

settings.actors: active human or service member with explicitly granted tenant permission
settings.disclosure: safe tenant overrides and responding API deployment defaults; no secrets or worker configuration
settings.eligibility: current permission, tenant.admin OAuth ceiling, exact settings ETag, idempotency and audited reason

personal.disclosure: owner only; current independent target permissions
personal.eligibility: exact membership/realm attribution and bounded selection
